paraphrase: An app whose primary account can be set up or signed in with a third-party social login must also offer an equivalent login that collects only name and email, lets the user hide their email, and does not collect interactions for advertising without consent; exempt when the app uses only its own account system, an enterprise or education account, a citizen identity system, or is a client for one specific third-party service.
quote: must also offer as an equivalent option another login service
